capabilities: show a formatting toolbar above the selected text after a short delay
apply inline, block, and callout formatting through core editor commands
copy the selection as plain text using 14 toggleable Markdown filters
configure popup delay, button labels, and per-button group toggles
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true); mobile is excluded because Obsidian already has a native formatting toolbar. Works only in Live Preview and Source mode. README states no network requests or telemetry. Install section references the community directory 'after approval'.
problem: On desktop, Obsidian has no popup toolbar for formatting selected text, and copying a selection keeps Markdown syntax in the clipboard.

relations.evidence: A companion plugin for Octavo, but it works with any theme.

summary: Selection popup toolbar that applies Markdown formatting via core commands, plus a configurable Copy as plain text command that strips syntax.
